blocks.text: Rio de Janeiro: a strip of sand by the water with mountain peaks beyond
6 February: Corcovado, the historic centre and the Carnival Ball

After breakfast, set out for Corcovado.

The eco-friendly train climbs through the Tijuca Forest.

Views of the city and bay open up as you ascend.

The Christ the Redeemer statue stands at the summit.

From the lookout, you can see the ocean, the beaches, Guanabara Bay, the Niterói Bridge, city neighbourhoods, mountains and lagoons.

After Corcovado, lunch is planned at Aprazível.

Lunch is paid for separately.

Then head to Rio’s historic centre.

See Arcos da Lapa, the famous aqueduct, and the Selarón Steps, decorated with colourful tiles from around the world.

You’ll also see the Municipal Theatre.

The itinerary includes a visit to the Metropolitan Cathedral, with its towering stained-glass windows.

We recommend dinner at Marius Degustare.

Dinner is not included.

The evening’s main event is the Carnival Ball at the Copacabana Palace.

It starts at 22:00.

Guests in evening wear and Carnival costumes fill the hotel’s grand halls.

The ball continues until dawn.

The Carnival Ball combines dancing, fine dining and Copacabana Palace service.
A helicopter and two people on a landing pad overlooking a bay in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
Rio de Janeiro: a helicopter on a landing pad by the bay in the evening
7 February: Helicopter flight over Rio and the Champions Parade at the Sambadrome

The morning is free after the previous night’s ball.

Have a late breakfast, spend time by the pool or take a walk along Copacabana.

**Excursion: Helicopter flight over Rio de Janeiro**

The flight lasts approximately 30 minutes.

A private transfer with a guide is included.
